text:
Aisha S: hey team, customer on free tier reporting repeated 429s and wants to know if we can bump their quota temporarily for onboarding. they say errors spike at ~100 reqs/min, bursts ~300 for ~2–3m and then 429s. customer id: org_7f9. they tried exponential backoff but still hit limits. any exceptions policy?

Marco L: can you paste the exact response headers + a sample request? 429s usually come with x-ratelimit headers so we can confirm if it's a global or per-route limit. also need first/last timestamps and x-request-id for our logs.

Aisha S: pasted headers below from customer's last 429 (they scrubbed API key):

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1763501289
Retry-After: 30
X-Request-Id: req_7b3f2a
```

Aisha S: sample curl they used:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"...","max_tokens":512}'
```

QuotaBot: automated note: org_7f9 is on Free tier — burst policy: soft-burst up to 5x short window, then enforced backoff. For sustained >limit, requests will be throttled. See https://console.redwood.ai/docs/rate-limits for details.

Marco L: thanks — this looks like they hit the short burst allowance and then got throttled to protect shared capacity. two paths: (1) guide them to implement client-side smoothing + Retry-After handling (fast fix), (2) sales-assisted temporary uplift or upgrade to paid plan / dedicated capacity for sustained higher QPS.

Aisha S: customer asked if we ever make exceptions for free tier (one-off bump) — they said it's a time-limited onboarding spike and they'd upgrade if we can help for 48–72h.

Priya K: we can do a short-term exception, but need expected peak QPS, duration, and business justification. pinging @Marco L for confirmation on operational risk. usual cadence: AE opens an exceptions case, ops grants a scoped, timeboxed uplift (audit logs + TTL). pricing note: dedicated/reserved capacity is recommended for predictable >200 QPS sustained.

Marco L: agree. need these from them: org id, expected sustained QPS, expected burst factor, timezone, and exact unix window when they expect spike. ops will apply a temporary rate-limit policy tied to their org id and an expiry. we'll need to schedule if it overlaps maintenance.

Aisha S: forwarded their reply, they want 400 peak QPS for 4 hours this Thurs 14:00–18:00 UTC and say they will upgrade afterwards. also provided request ids: req_7b3f2a, req_7b3f2b, req_7b3f2c during the spike.

Marco L: ok please open a support ticket with those ids and label it "ops:temp-quota-uplift". I'll pre-approve a small bump to allow 400 peak for that 4h window (we'll apply a leaky-bucket cap so shared infra isn't impacted). I'll also add a note to monitoring so alerts don't auto-escalate to paging.

Priya K: i'll draft an exceptions quote and email the customer the short-term uplift terms (audit, TTL, pricing follow-up). Aisha — can you confirm billing contact and whether they want us to pro-rate a single-day upgrade or handle post-hoc invoice?

Aisha S: billing contact is billing@customer.com. they prefer pro-rate + immediate upgrade path to Pro after the trial. also asked about whether they'd need to rotate keys to get higher limits (they should not — limits are org-scoped).

Marco L: correct — limits are org-scoped. quick mitigation recommendations you can pass to them now: 1) implement exponential backoff + jitter, respect Retry-After header, 2) batch inputs if possible to reduce req/sec, 3) lower max_tokens or use streaming so tokens are cheaper, 4) use caching for repeated prompts.

Aisha S: thanks. i'll open the support ticket now and set the SLA to P2. adding ticket id: SUP-10243.

QuotaBot: SUP-10243 created and linked to org_7f9; temporary policy scheduled: start=1763505600 end=1763512800 scope=org_7f9 limit=burst:400 sustained:100.

Marco L: i'll monitor during the window and remove the temporary policy after end time. if we see abuse patterns we'll revoke earlier.

Priya K: i'll send the quote and include the upgrade path doc + pricing link. Aisha — please close the loop with customer once uplift is confirmed. :thumbsup:

Aisha S: will do — leaving this thread open until after the window. thanks everyone.
